A village taverna in Emba

A locally run taverna in Emba, a bit away from the seaside, with meze, kleftiko and grilled meat. On Google, 4.8 stars from 144 reviews.

What guests mention

What guests mention most

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Fish and meat meze

10 Google reviews mention the meze and 2 seafood. One guest writes about a fish and meat meze, seafood mains and grilled lamb chops, all reasonably priced.

Kleftiko and moussaka

2 reviews mention the kleftiko and 2 the moussaka. One guest simply writes that the kleftiko was amazing.

Frequented by locals

2 reviews mention that locals come here and 3 the kind staff. Guests describe an excellent locally run taverna in a lovely village location.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Next to the old church

One guest writes that the taverna is right next to the historic church, still with a view of the sea.

Heartfelt hospitality

One guest describes the hospitality as outstanding, friendly, attentive and truly heartfelt, another writes that the owner was a star.

Worth the drive

One guest looked for a place a bit away from the seaside and writes that it was totally worth the drive, and came back on the last evening.

What guests say

Three of 144 Google reviews, 127 of them with five stars.
